'''Treece''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]], who lived on the primitive [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ceriun]] about [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. He was an associate of the [[Drop Canyon]] village leader, [[Ka'arn]]. His son was one of the youths involved in an attempt to steal a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] that had come into the possession of the villagers.
